title: True Icon
bio: “True Icon” is the fourth song JinnaWoods recorded, produced by periyuh in early 2022. The recording process was emotionally intense and experimental, marking one of the final collaborations between Jinna and peri. After their split, they released the five recorded songs as the *Heelz* EP. The track was later remixed and sampled across multiple projects, including *The Iconic Pop*, *EMOtional SLAYage*, and *The Candidates*.
